intro.h2: Tub and tile refinishing in Port Orange, FL, without tearing it all out
paragraphs: Pro Spray Refinishing LLC handles tub and tile refinishing in Port Orange, FL, and refinishes kitchen cabinets too. A refinish gives worn surfaces a clean new look without the cost and mess of ripping them out. One customer says we did a beautiful job on her bathroom tub and tile, worked neatly and fast, and charged a reasonable price.

Herb and Shawna also paint and finish whole rooms. One couple brought us in after another company set their new vanity and granite: we painted the master bedroom, the master bath and two guest baths, fixed tile gaps, hung four light fixtures and new mirrors and installed a toilet. They called the price fair and the work excellent.

items.name: Tub and tile refinishing
items.blurb: A dated or worn tub and tile surround can look new again without demolition. Bathroom tub refinishing is one of the topics our Google reviewers mention, and one customer says we did a beautiful job on her tub and tile, kept things neat and finished fast.

items.name: Bathroom makeovers and finish work
items.blurb: Some bathrooms just need the right finishing touches. We fix tile gaps, hang light fixtures and mirrors, install toilets and paint, and we work alongside other trades when someone else is setting the vanity or countertop. The result is a bathroom that feels finished.

about.text: Pro Spray Refinishing LLC is based on S Waterbridge Circle in Port Orange, FL, and is listed on Google as a bathroom remodeler. Herb and Shawna are the names our customers know, and they show up to do the work themselves. We refinish tubs, tile and kitchen cabinets, paint inside and out, and handle the finish work that makes a bathroom feel complete, from light fixtures and mirrors to a new toilet. Google shows more than 100 photos of our jobs. We are open weekdays from 7 AM to 7 PM and Saturday from 8 AM to 4 PM.

process.h2: How a Pro Spray job goes

steps.title: Call us
steps.text: Call (386) 307-6783 weekdays from 7 AM to 7 PM or Saturday from 8 AM to 4 PM and tell us what needs a new finish.

steps.title: Look and estimate
steps.text: We look at the tub, tile, cabinets or walls, explain what refinishing or painting can do and give you a price.

steps.title: Prep and protect
steps.text: We protect the rest of the room before spraying or painting, so the only thing that changes is the surface you asked for.

steps.title: Refinish and finish
steps.text: Herb and Shawna do the work neatly and quickly, along with any fixtures, mirrors or small repairs that are part of the job.

steps.title: Walk it together
steps.text: We check the result with you and leave the room clean, ready to use once the new finish has had time to cure.

service_area.h2: Tub and tile refinishing around Port Orange, FL
service_area.text: Pro Spray Refinishing LLC works from 4049 S Waterbridge Cir in Port Orange, FL, refinishing tubs, tile and cabinets and painting homes in the area. If you are nearby and wondering whether we can come to you, call (386) 307-6783 with your address and a short description of the job, and we will let you know when we can stop by.

items.q: What can be refinished instead of replaced?
items.a: Bathtubs, tile and kitchen cabinets are the most common. Refinishing gives them a fresh surface without tearing them out, which saves demolition and keeps the room usable sooner. Tell us what you have, whether a worn tub or dated cabinets, and we will tell you honestly if a refinish makes sense.

items.q: Do you do bathroom remodels too?
items.a: We focus on refinishing, painting and finish work. In one master bath remodel another company installed the new vanity and granite, and we painted, fixed tile gaps, hung four light fixtures and new mirrors and installed a new toilet. The owners called the result a bathroom makeover they were so happy with.

items.q: Can you paint my porch or furniture?
items.a: Yes. One family had us repaint the inside of their screened porch, which had not been painted in ten years, and later asked us back to spray paint four chairs and two benches. Interior rooms, bathrooms and smaller pieces like these are all regular work for us.

items.q: Who will be working in my home?
items.a: Herb and Shawna. Customers mention them by name and describe a very professional, thorough job. Reviews describe them doing the hands-on work themselves, from repainting a screened porch to spraying chairs and benches. Call (386) 307-6783 to talk with them about your project.

We are open Monday through Friday from 7 AM to 7 PM and Saturday from 8 AM to 4 PM, and closed on Sunday. Call (386) 307-6783 to talk about your project. Our address is 4049 S Waterbridge Cir, Port Orange, FL 32129.

final_cta.h2: Give your tub or cabinets a second life
final_cta.text: Call Herb and Shawna at Pro Spray Refinishing for an estimate.
